description: This file defines the 'Column' class used in the PhpSpreadsheet library to manage autofilter columns in an Excel worksheet. It includes properties and methods for handling filter types, rules, attributes, and parent relationships.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents an autofilter column in a worksheet, managing filter rules, types, attributes, and its relation to the parent AutoFilter object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Column with the specified column letter and optional parent AutoFilter.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column letter (e.g., 'A').

methods.name: setColumnIndex
methods.description: Sets the column letter, converting to uppercase and validating the range via parent.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent AutoFilter object.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Assigns a new parent AutoFilter to the column.

methods.name: getFilterType
methods.description: Returns the current filter type applied to the column.

methods.name: setFilterType
methods.description: Sets a new filter type, validating against allowed types and rules count for custom filters.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Returns the logical join type ('and' or 'or') for multiple rules.

methods.name: setJoin
methods.description: Sets the rule join type, validating input.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Assigns an array of attributes to the column.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute by name.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value by name.

methods.name: ruleCount
methods.description: Returns the count of rules set for this column.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Retrieves all filter rules associated with this column.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a filter rule at the specified index.

methods.name: createRule
methods.description: Creates and appends a new filter rule, respecting custom filter rule limits.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Adds an existing rule to the column.

methods.name: deleteRule
methods.description: Removes a rule at a specified index and resets join if necessary.

methods.name: clearRules
methods.description: Removes all rules and resets join to 'or'.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Deep clones the Column object, including its rules.
